description: In front of you on the bed are a white open slipcase standing upright near the pillow and several small paperback books scattered around it. The left hand rests on the blanket while the right hand picks up a red book from the right, moves it left, and slides it upright into the open slipcase; then the right hand grabs a blue book and stands it next to the red inside/against the slipcase, and finally lifts the green book and places it upright alongside the others, releasing it so the three books form a neat row.
